messages:
Jules: Heads up — noticed a spike in late-token hallucination on the FP8 fast path for long-context QA workloads. baseline INT8 looks fine, but FP8 shows coherent answers that later go off the rails around token ~1024.

Nina: :eyes: can you paste the failing prompt/run? is this synthetic or customer traffic?

Jules: Customer repro (redacted) — reproduces on our staging cluster with batch_size=8, seq_len 2048. Happens ~30% of runs.

Kai: Any recent changes to scale/clipping or per-head rescale? we shipped the adaptive scale clip PR last week.

Jules: Yeah we toggled the new scale clip on fp8 lanes for throughput. Quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T14:02:03Z] model=redwood/v1-fp8 path=fast fp8_scale_clip=1.2 output_score=0.87
[2026-03-22T14:02:03Z] kv_cache_hit=true token_idx=1025 deg_score=0.41
[2026-03-22T14:02:04Z] token_idx=1026 output_score=0.23 ALERT: factuality_drop
```

bench-bot: automated-sampler report: fp8_fast_path failure cohort increased by 3.4x over 48h vs control. p<0.01.

Sam: Did we run cross-format shadow eval with the new clip param? I thought we had a canary.

Jules: Canary was small (N=100), mostly short prompts. This only surfaces for long prompts and KV re-use.

Aj: Hypothesis: scale clip interacts with KV normalization across chunk boundaries. FP8 quantization reduces margin so the clip causes tipping later. Could also be headwise saturation.

Kai: Agreed. Two quick experiments: 1) disable fp8_scale_clip on longctx lanes, 2) increase clip threshold to 1.5 and rerun 5k shadow samples. Also add per-head saturation telemetry.

Nina: +1. For prod safety we should add a temporary runtime fallback: if deg_score > 0.3 on token > 900, route to INT8 variant for remainder of generation. Leaves early tokens on fp8 to save cost.

Jules: Good call. I'll prototype a routing predicate in the runtime:
```
if (token_idx>900 && deg_score>0.3 && model_variant.startsWith('fp8')) {
  routeTo('int8_fallback')
}
```

Sam: Ops note — ensure this fallback emits a trace and sample of final tokens so we can diff quality. tag with `fp8-fallback-2026-03-22`.

ops-bot: Deploy plan required: change is config-only for routing predicate + telemetry flags. Rollout recommended: canary 5% for 24h, monitor deg_score, BLEU-like and perplexity on eval prompt set.

Aj: Longer term: create a regression test that includes long-context KV reuse scenarios in our shadow-eval harness. Also need a lint that flags aggressive fp8 clip params for models with >1024 avg seq.

Jules: I'll open an RFC follow-up with proposed runtime predicate, canary steps, and suggested metric dashboards. tagging @Kai @Nina for review.

Nina: Thanks — if we see immediate improvement with disable/raise clip we can revert clip change and push a more conservative param set. :thumbsup:

Kai: I'll add headwise saturation counters to the GPU telemetry pipeline tonight.

Sam: Ping me when the canary config is ready, I'll stand up monitoring.

Jules: Thanks team — creating issue and PRs now.
